source_name: Banka Slovenije - Prijava kršitev (whistleblowing channel page)
why_relevant: Reveals indirectly which entity types BS considers itself to supervise and which breach categories it prioritises; low direct content value but useful for scoping supervisory perimeter.

source_name: Sibos (Swift) – annual conference programme and delegate/speaker directory
why_relevant: Swift's flagship event; Slovenian banks that are Swift members occasionally speak or exhibit. The programme and session archive is the canonical venue where correspondent-banking and ISO 20022 roadmaps are discussed. Recorded here as a category-level source because the live sibos.com agenda URL was not directly confirmed in this pass.

source_name: Borza dela (borzadela.si) - job search aggregator
why_relevant: Another SI aggregator surfacing employer-keyword pages (e.g. 'banka slovenije'); useful redundancy for ads pulled quickly from primary boards.

source_name: BTC d.d. – sporočila za medije (media releases)
why_relevant: BTC City Ljubljana is the anchor merchant partner of the Slovenian crypto-payments cluster (joint GoCrypto milestones). A listed retail/real-estate company whose media releases document merchant-side adoption events with dates.

source_name: Central European Times
why_relevant: CEE-regional English outlet that covered the OTP–NKBM acquisition and merger plan with SKB; useful as an additional cross-check layer for Hungarian/Austrian bank moves into Slovenia, though editorially lighter than SeeNews or bne.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – quarterly supervisory statistics press releases and PDF reports
why_relevant: Narrative quarterly commentary that names Slovenia in country league tables (NIM, NPL, CET1); easier to cite than raw series and dated for trend tracking.

source_name: EY Slovenija – services and insights (audit, forensics, sustainability)
why_relevant: Fourth Big Four local practice; audit and FAAS leadership named locally, and EY global FS/payments studies are localised here — useful for supply-side signals on who advises Slovenian banks.

source_name: financialreports.eu - NLB filings aggregator
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator indexing NLB filings and financial statements. Useful as a redundancy/monitoring layer and to detect filings quickly, but must be treated as secondary - always resolve back to the issuer or SEOnet original.

source_name: Forum Media — Portal Javna naročila / javni razpisi
why_relevant: Publisher-run procurement portal with practitioner commentary on ZJN-3 practice and tender listings; helpful for interpreting Slovenian procurement procedure vocabulary and for spotting notable tenders, not for primary data.

source_name: Genis d.o.o. — e-Računi / document workflow vendor
why_relevant: Slovenian DMS/e-invoicing vendor whose product pages describe two-way integration with external providers and banks' invoice flows. Relevant to the back-office software layer sold into financial institutions; product pages sometimes name integration partners.

source_name: JavniRazpisi.com — commercial tender aggregator (IT / programska oprema branch)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that categorises Slovenian tenders by sector and publishes derived market statistics (e.g. software contract counts and aggregate values by period). Useful as a cross-check and for sector taxonomy, but derived and partly paywalled — never a primary citation.

source_name: Mastercard Slovenia country site (mastercard.si)
why_relevant: Card scheme country presence; where Slovenia-specific scheme announcements, consumer research and acceptance initiatives would be published in Slovenian. Confirmed to exist as a localised sl-si tree.

source_name: mjob.si - Slovenian job portal
why_relevant: Additional SI board identified via competitor analysis of optius.com/ess.gov.si; worth a coverage check so that bank ads posted only on secondary boards are not missed.

source_name: NiceHash – company site and Slovenian media coverage cluster
why_relevant: Major Slovenian crypto-infrastructure company (hashpower marketplace + exchange/wallet features, Ljubljana/Maribor). Corporate blog plus dense Slovenian media coverage (RTVSLO, Delo, Siol, 24ur) make it trackable both directly and indirectly.

source_name: NIL (part of Conscia) — network/security integrator, Slovenia
why_relevant: Established Slovenian infrastructure/security systems integrator; banks are a core vertical for this class of supplier. Its Slovenian corporate/reference pages are a candidate pointer to bank infrastructure engagements.

source_name: Svet24.si — economy/banking news
why_relevant: Tabloid-leaning national outlet that nonetheless republishes bank benchmarking findings (E-laborat digital banking comparison 2026) with bank-level rankings. Useful as an access-friendly mirror when the same study is paywalled at Večer/Finance.

source_name: TheBanks.eu – bank profile and credit-ratings aggregator for Slovenian institutions
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that consolidates current Moody's/Fitch/S&P grades per Slovenian bank in one comparable page (e.g. OTP banka BBB-/A3), handy as a fast cross-bank snapshot before paying for agency data.

source_name: Total Slovenia News — banking tag
why_relevant: Independent English-language Slovenia news aggregator/translator with a dedicated banking tag; lower authority than STA but often carries translated summaries of Slovenian press (Delo, Finance, Dnevnik) that are otherwise paywalled or SL-only.

source_name: Varuh človekovih pravic RS (Human Rights Ombudsman) – annual reports and initiatives
why_relevant: Not a banking ombudsman, but its annual reports and initiatives cover systemic consumer/financial-exclusion issues (e.g. access to basic payment accounts, treatment of vulnerable customers) and it has historically discussed proposals for sectoral ombudsmen.

source_name: Zaposlitev.info - banking/finance category
why_relevant: Small SI board with a dedicated banking/finance category; low volume but occasionally carries ads from smaller savings banks and payment intermediaries.
